# Vendored: tree-sitter-twig

- Upstream: https://github.com/gbprod/tree-sitter-twig (MIT; relicensed from WTFPL on 2026-08-25, commit b67fafe842)
- Commit: `2208d2a3c3ee7ef378e97df2e51c18feb7ee9dfc` (main, 2026-08-31, "Merge pull request #31 from fabpot/fix/string-escape-lexing")
- Not published on crates.io (the name `tree-sitter-twig` returns 404 there), and `cargo deny` bans git dependencies, so the generated parser is vendored.
- `src/parser.c` sha256 `d4a9aee5e54e9abdd743bde5c1e3e686f736052f8b4a3810aee9e4e93486e3cf` (generated by tree-sitter 0.25.10, ABI 15), `src/tree_sitter/*.h` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged.
- Ours: `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, `lib.rs` (upstream's `bindings/rust` minus its dev-dependency on `tree-sitter`, which would pull a second `tree-sitter` into the lockfile).
- Refresh: download the tarball of a newer commit, copy the same files, update this note, re-run `cargo nextest run -p sg-analysis`.
